problem_being_solved.authority_text: Q-4a: a discernible mid-depth kurtosis band exists on the 7B target
problem_being_solved.why_that_is_not_yet_a_criterion: 'discernible' is unquantified, so applied after the fact it degrades into a judgement call about a curve one has already seen. Any noisy curve has a maximum somewhere.
problem_being_solved.resolution: quantify it now, before the curve exists, and make it falsifiable

quantity.statistic: per-layer excess kurtosis of the readout logit distribution, kappa(l) for l = 0..27
quantity.activations_from: heldout rows only; the A and B rows are reserved for fitting and may not be reused

C1.name: interior maximum
C1.why: a maximum at the first or last layer is what a monotone trend looks like, not what a band looks like

C2.name: contiguity
C2.requirement: with tau = kappa_min + 0.5 * (kappa_max - kappa_min), the candidate band is the LONGEST CONTIGUOUS run of layers with kappa(l) >= tau
C2.why_a_relative_threshold: an absolute kurtosis threshold would have to be invented, and no such value is registered anywhere
C2.why_longest_contiguous_run: a band is a connected region; scattered layers above a threshold are not a band

C3.name: coverage
C3.requirement: the candidate band spans at least 7 layers, which is at least 25 percent of depth
C3.why: a two- or three-layer bump is a spike, not a workspace band

C4.name: cross-fit agreement
C4.why: A and B are independent fits on disjoint halves; a band that does not reproduce across them is a property of one sample, not of the model

C5.name: exceeds the null
C5.requirement: kappa(l) inside the candidate band exceeds the matched-norm random-J null curve at every layer in the band, and the within-band mean difference is at least the pre-registered margin
C5.null_construction: replace each J_l with a random matrix of the SAME Frobenius norm, leave the rest of the readout path identical, and use the same heldout activations
C5.why_matched_norm: an unmatched random matrix would differ from J in scale as well as in structure, so exceeding it would demonstrate nothing about structure
C5.why_this_criterion_is_the_load_bearing_o: without a null, 'a band exists' is unfalsifiable: any noisy curve has a maximum, a half-height threshold and a contiguous run above it. C1 to C4 describe a shape; only C5 asks whether the shape carries information.

the_published_prior_is_excluded_from_the.prior: the workspace paper's depth-reindexed band of approximately [38, 92], which on 28 layers corresponds to roughly layers 11 to 26
the_published_prior_is_excluded_from_the.may_be_used_for: an after-the-fact comparison in the report only
the_published_prior_is_excluded_from_the.why: whether the derived band agrees with the prior is a RESULT. Letting the prior shape the derivation would convert it into an input and the agreement would then be circular.

descriptive_companion_not_part_of_any_cr.curve: logit-lens kappa(l) computed through the identical readout path with use_jacobian = False
descriptive_companion_not_part_of_any_cr.purpose: the published claim is that the J-lens stays interpretable at early layers where the logit lens is noise; this curve tests that claim directly rather than repeating it

outcomes.pass: all five hold; record band_A, band_B and the registered band as their intersection, and report the comparison with the prior

fail.what_it_means: the construct was not established on this model, and therefore NOTHING WAS MEASURED
fail.what_it_does_not_mean: it is NOT evidence that J-space is absent at 7B
fail.may_not_be_written_up_as: a negative finding about J-space, or cited by any later text as negative evidence

claim_ceiling: A kurtosis curve is not evidence of J-space. It is a gate that decides whether later measurement is qualified to proceed. Nothing here is a scientific result.
